title: croton surinamensis
intro: Croton surinamensis, commonly known as Surinam Croton, is a medicinal plant native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. It has been used for its health benefits, which include treating fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, suppress coughs, and fight off bacterial and fungal infections. The bioactive constituents present in Croton surinamensis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
